messages:
lina: quick follow-up from the postmortem  noticed a recurring pattern: token validation drift + missing rotation audit events every ~90 days. want to lock owners and a recurring remediation cadence.
oscar: agreed. i'd prefer a quarterly sweep owned by infra with rotating on-call for the run. i'll volunteer Q2.
taylor: i'll take the immediate fixes: token ttl enforcement CI, audit pipeline sanity checks, and a post-rotate verification script.
infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4999  quarterly authz sweep setup (https://tracker.redwood/INFRA-4999)
lina: proposed operational rules: 1) token TTLs: user <=30d, service <=7d; 2) quarterly sweep scheduled first Tue of quarter; 3) runbook for bulk rotates + prechecks.
oscar: for ownership, assign infra-ops to schedule and run, eng-security to verify audit coverage, and app teams to remediate service-specific regressions.
taylor: draft CI job i'll add:
```
# quick TTL checker
python ops/check_ttls.py --env prod --threshold 0.5
```
will send PD if >0.5% of tokens exceed limits.
eng-security: we'll add audit-coverage gating to the rotation playbook and run a sample validation post-rotate.
lina: action summary to add to remediation board:
- oscar: setup INFRA-4999 schedule + owner rotation  due 2026-04-10
- taylor: token TTL CI + PD + verification script  due 2026-04-05
- eng-security: audit gating + post-rotate validation checklist  due 2026-04-03
- lina: update runbook with cadence and TTL defaults  due 2026-03-30
oscar: i'll link tasks into the remediation tracker and book the first sweep. re-open here if anything blocks :thumbsup:
